name: Deshi Baluarte-Thorvaldsen

physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and thick-necked, muscular but softened by age and desk work. Carries weight in his torso; forearms remain corded and strong.
physical_description.hair_color: Steel gray with residual black at the temples
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, shot through with deep gray
physical_description.complexion: Strong jawline, lines around the eyes and mouth from decades of negotiation and command. Slight scar tissue on his left cheekbone. Five o'clock shadow, meticulous grooming otherwise.
distinguishing_marks: Thin horizontal scar across his left cheekbone, approximately 3cm, from a knife fight in his thirties
Network of pale burn scars across his right shoulder and upper arm, partially obscured by clothing
Tattoo on his inner left wrist: a Scandinavian rune (ᚦ, Thurisaz) in faded black ink, likely 30+ years old
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None immediately obvious. Wears a military-grade smartwatch on his right wrist with a discrete Arcturus corporate logo. Slight neural port scarring behind his right ear, barely visible unless he pulls his hair back.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy—no wasted motion. Stands with his shoulders squared, a habit from military life. Handshakes are firm and brief. He leans back when listening, eyes narrow slightly when calculating.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 1-2 corporate military aesthetic: charcoal wool slacks, pressed crisply; gray or black dress shirts with reinforced polymer weave (ballistic-rated, though not visibly). Dark tactical jacket (Arcturus-branded, understated embroidery). Shoes are black leather combat boots, polished to a mirror finish. Small Φ currency clip on his belt. No excessive chrome or visible corpo swagger—his status is conveyed through fabric quality and cuts, not flashiness.

image_prompt: Professional male fixer in his mid-50s, mixed South Asian and Scandinavian heritage, steel-gray pomaded hair, sharp jaw with weathered scar tissue, dark brown eyes. Wearing charcoal wool slacks and reinforced black tactical jacket, understated corporate military wear. Standing in a dimly lit Geartown warehouse office, neon signs bleeding through frosted windows behind him, cool blue and amber overhead lighting. Composed, dangerous, calculated expression.
